title: Creases of keystones carry scars carved. Tasked with keeping An Arc connected while weight of unwilling waver in the wind #smallpoems
summary: Creases of keystones carry scars carved. Tasked with keeping An Arc connected while weight of unwilling waver in the wind #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Creases of
keystones
carry scars
carved.

Tasked with
  keeping
An Arc
  connected
while
weight of
  unwilling
waver in the
    wind
#smallpoems
